proves.claim: A foreign test that declares a source-cell path read counts once without unsealing the target cell; a target cell's own declared read counts zero; the path-reader ratchet refuses growth above zero and permits a lower count.

gate.io-test-path-read-sealing.a-cell-re.why: Declared path reads are invisible to imports, so the seal must count foreign readers and enforce its ratchet without treating them as deep importers.
